key_eligibility_patterns.citizenship_requirement: Most schemes require Singapore Citizenship (SC) or Permanent Resident (PR) status
key_eligibility_patterns.income_thresholds: Multiple tiered income thresholds ($4,000-$16,000 monthly depending on household type)
key_eligibility_patterns.property_restrictions: First-timer and no private property ownership within 30 months common across housing schemes
key_eligibility_patterns.application_requirements: Most schemes now use online portals (HDB Portal, GovBenefits, e-Stamping, AIC eServices)

key_benefit_patterns.cash_payouts: Direct cash assistance ranging $200-$2,250 depending on scheme
key_benefit_patterns.housing_support: Grants, loans, subsidies, and priority allocation for flat purchases
key_benefit_patterns.healthcare_support: Subsidised consultations, MediSave top-ups, preventive care programs
key_benefit_patterns.tax_incentives: Stamp duty remissions for family transfers and couple purchases
